decisions.statement: Run the projection worker with bounded concurrency.
decisions.decision: Run the projection worker with bounded concurrency.
decisions.choice: Process eight messages concurrently and expose backlog depth
alternatives: Create an unbounded task per message
rationale: A fixed limit protects memory while keeping the fictional demo responsive
constraints: Single-node runtime with 512 MB worker budget
risks: A fixed limit may underuse faster machines
decisions.outcome: Synthetic load tests held memory below 310 MB at 25,000 events per minute.
